owner: W1-17 (dialogue). RI-DLG04 §B: 'Faction reaction is a matrix, not a flag.'
roster_owner: W1-20 owns the faction roster and its ranks (game/data/progression/factions.json). This file is the ORDERED-PAIR reaction matrix the disposition formula indexes; it covers every faction id that appears anywhere under game/data/** today.
application: derivedDisposition() adds (fDispFactionRankMult*rank + fDispFactionRankBase) * fDispFactionMod * reaction. With the shipped GMSTs that is (0.5*rank + 1) * 3 * reaction: a rank-0 member of a faction whose self-reaction is +2 gets +6; a rank-5 Ninth Cohort officer talking to House Dres (reaction -3) gets (0.5*5+1)*3*-3 = -31.5. Rank AMPLIFIES the sign, in both directions. That is the design: the higher you climb in one house, the more the rival house sees you coming.
worst_reaction_rule: When the player belongs to several factions the engine takes the WORST reaction the speaker's faction holds toward any of them (RI-DLG04 §B, argmin). Joining a rival costs you, permanently and visibly.
self_reaction_note: The diagonal is NOT 0. RI-DLG04 §B reads factionReaction(npc.faction, npc.faction) for members, so the diagonal is what being one of us is worth. It varies: the Rootkeepers are warm to their own (+4), the Wet Ledger is a business relationship (+2), the Blackwood Company pays you and does not love you (+1).

load_bearing_cells.why: The corpus's Camonna-Tong/Thieves-Guild pair. Two criminal organisations competing for the same river. A Wet Ledger rank-4 walking into a Drowned Court room takes (0.5*4+1)*3*-4 = -36 disposition and will be refused everything including the parley.
House Dres took Argonians for three centuries. There is no rank at which a Dres oathman is welcome in the interior.
One tends the wells, the other sells what comes out of them. This is a THEOLOGICAL dispute with a commercial surface, and it is why the Sap-Cutters cannot buy their way into a sapwell.

The strongest diagonal in the matrix. RG-DEEP already gives a saxhleel +14 before this term; a rank-3 Deep-Kin adds (0.5*3+1)*3*4 = +30 on top. Being interior-born and interior-sworn is the single largest social advantage available, and it is unavailable to a Dunmer character at any price.

asymmetry_note: 14 of the 66 unordered pairs are authored ASYMMETRICALLY, which is the whole reason this is a matrix of ordered pairs and not a table of grudges. Verify with tools/dialogue/faction-matrix-audit.mjs. The ones that carry weight: xul-aneekh→wet-ledger is -2 while wet-ledger→xul-aneekh is 0 — the interior distrusts the smugglers, the smugglers do not care either way, which is exactly what an asymmetry of power looks like from below. rootkeepers→wet-ledger is -2 while wet-ledger→rootkeepers is 0, the same shape: contempt travels up the hierarchy of self-regard, not down it. drowned-court→xul-aneekh is +2 but xul-aneekh→drowned-court is only +1, because the Court claims a kinship the interior does not fully return. ninth-cohort→shadowscale-order is -3 while shadowscale-order→ninth-cohort is -2, because the Legion has a name for them and they do not have a name for the Legion.
alias_note: W1-07 round 4. `roster_owner` above claimed this file covers every faction id that appears anywhere under game/data/**, and it did not: the quest files, faction-gates.json and the NPC records all name factions in an UNDERSCORE vocabulary (`the_xul_aneekh`, `house_dres`, `deep_kin`) while this matrix is indexed in a HYPHEN vocabulary with a partly different roster. Nothing reconciled them, so RI-DLG04 §B's faction term resolved every live id to `undefined` — a silent 0 — and `race-reactions.json` §repair_paths' one disposition repair ("Deep-Kin rank 6 against a Deep-Kin NPC is +48, which fully covers a Dunmer's -40") could not fire. `sim/dialogue/disposition.js normaliseFactionId()` reads this table first and falls back to dropping `the_` and turning `_` into `-`. `deep_kin` and `the_xul_aneekh` are the same body under two names in the quest data; the Ixtu-Vakh ARE the Sap-Cutters (race-reactions.json RG-VAKH says so); the Imperial Assize is read as the Provincial Office, the Imperial civil administration this matrix does carry. A null is an EXPLICIT declaration that the id has no row and is meant to score 0 — the Dockhands are a labour body with no cross-faction politics — so that an unresolved id is never mistaken for an unnoticed one. W1-20 ROUND 3: the `the_dockhands: null` above said the Dockhands are "a labour body with no cross-faction politics", and the consequence was measured in W1-20-r2 — their own representative `npc-porter-eeja` sat at disposition 47 at ranks 0, 2, 4 AND 7 while the other seven lines moved 21-24 points across the same span. The diagonal is what BEING ONE OF US is worth (see self_reaction_note), so a null diagonal is not neutrality about outsiders, it is your own foreman not noticing you have become a gang boss. The row is now authored; the cross-faction cells are mostly small, which is the original judgement kept.
